description:
Retrieve explainable step-by-step chain-of-thought rationale, candidate utilities, and risk assessment for past decisions (actions: latest, get, list, explain). Use get_decision_trace instead of query_knowledge when performing deep forensic analysis of a specific historical decision.

Returns step-by-step reasoning trace, utility breakdown, candidate rankings, and explanation text.
